message: I have a friend who panics at the drop of a hat. The other day, she texted me in a frenzy because she heard a storm was coming, and she was convinced we’d be stuck without anything. While I helped her breathe through the moment, I realized how reassuring it is to have a little preparedness in place. A simple go-bag with snacks, water, and important documents can turn a stressful situation into a manageable one. It’s all about finding that calm in the chaos! How do you keep your mind at ease when the unexpected happens?
